sloka: तस्माद्धतहयाद्वीरः सो ऽवप्लुत्य महारथात्।गदां जग्राह सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसो ऽथ महोदरः ।। ६.९८.१९ ।।
transliteration: tasmāddhatahayādvīraḥ so 'vaplutya mahārathāt।gadāṁ jagrāha saṅkruddho rākṣaso 'tha mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.19 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, picking up that glowing iron bar, exhibiting its top, whirling it around, struck the best of horses of Mahodara.
